raw_case_text: Although the role of HHV8 in KD is demonstrated in the occurrence of KD, cofactors remain poorly understood. We report here a case of KD occurring after a 10-year-old vascular trauma on a patient from Central Africa with HIV infection.

subjective.chief_complaint: A patient from Central Africa presenting with localized lesions developing after a vascular trauma ten years prior.
subjective.past_medical_history: Vascular trauma sustained 10 years prior. Epidemiological origin: Central Africa.

assessment_and_plan.assessment_and_confirmation: Definitive diagnosis: Kaposi disease (KD) associated with human herpesvirus 8 (HHV8) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection occurring in a patient from Central Africa at the site of vascular trauma sustained 10 years previously.
